risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: phishing mail from aegean-edu.co delivered (F2) and clicked by the user (F1), followed by MFA fatigue with 7 denied pushes then 1 approval from 185.220.101.7 (F7). The same IP then performed 38 successful SIS events within 60 minutes (F4). Additional confirmed indicators: suspicious NL ASN sign-ins outside baseline (F8), impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa (F5), and an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F3) indicating persistence/exfiltration. The rejected password-spray claim does not weaken this case. Per policy, confirmed ATO chain = contain.
